aggregate: Report ImageNet results by backbone and backend; match sample order, probes, initialization and effective update counts. Preserve the historical nine-context estimate separately.
calibration: FP32/AMP equivalence gates at full and tail batch sizes; only equivalence uses the calibrated scale. Reset model, optimizer, scaler and RNG before timing.
compile_backend: torch.compile with the cudagraphs backend; require actual training graph launches
dataset_partition: ImageNet-100 full_train, same official 126689 training examples; exclude official test
design: Post-review real DataLoader epoch-one timing; one wall-time per unit
initialization: Fresh random weights at fixed seed; match common backbone tensor values within each context and verify identical state for the two backends.
loader: Read-only prepared Arrow train split, original engine HFImageView, transforms, sampler and DataLoader
repeats: One measured epoch per unit. No across-seed accuracy or timing confidence interval.
timer: Wall seconds for one full real loader pass including loader startup, augmentation, transfer, forward/backward, optimizer updates, original epoch-end model-state validation and parameter snapshot. CUDA synchronization bounds the interval. Compile, warm-up, equivalence gates, checkpoint I/O and test evaluation are outside.
